seams.title: Accountable owner leaves before launch
evidence: hr/roster.csv: E004 last working day 2026-11-27, before launch 2026-12-01
legal/obligations_register.csv: OBL-L-001, OBL-L-003, OBL-L-006 owned by E004
finance/approval_limits.csv: E004 is the only approver for QuickPay product spend, no delegate
seams.why_no_single_department_sees_it: HR sees a normal leaver process. Legal sees a named owner. Finance sees a valid approver. Only together do they show the owner is gone at launch.
seams.detection_logic: Owner or approver status is left, or serving notice with last working day before launch; scope has no other active approver.
seams.suggested_resolution: Name a successor, reassign Legal obligations, update the Finance approval table and reroute pending purchase orders.
seams.resolver_role: Head of HR with General Counsel and Head of Finance

seams.title: Sellers without valid conduct training at launch
evidence: hr/product_staffing.csv: 8 sellers assigned to QuickPay sales from 2026-12-01
hr/training_records.csv: E013 PCT-101 expires 2026-11-25; E014 and E015 never started
seams.why_no_single_department_sees_it: HR's mandatory list has only COC-100 and DPA-110. Legal holds the rule but not the training records.
seams.detection_logic: For each seller, PCT-101 must be valid on the launch date; no record, not started, or expiry before launch is a violation.
seams.suggested_resolution: Complete training before launch or remove the three from selling until they are valid.
seams.resolver_role: Head of Sales with Head of HR

seams.title: Customer data processed outside UK and EEA
evidence: product/product_record.json: StreamLedger (V002) receives customer payment data in v2.0
finance/vendors.csv: V002 handles customer data, processing region US-East
seams.why_no_single_department_sees_it: Finance records the region but not the contract promise. Legal records the promise and a signed DPA but not the region.
seams.detection_logic: Processors in the product's data flows that handle customer data with a processing region outside UK and EEA.
seams.suggested_resolution: Move processing to UK or EEA, or remove StreamLedger from the v2.0 data flow before launch.

seams.title: 24x7 support promised without staff or budget
evidence: legal/customer_terms_v2.0_excerpt.md: 9.1 24x7 with two agents at all times
finance/budget.csv: B-001 six FTE, business hours only
seams.why_no_single_department_sees_it: Legal wrote the promise. Finance funded business hours. HR is within headcount and the freeze. No one compares required hours with available hours.
seams.detection_logic: Required staffed hours (168 x 2 = 336) minus agents x weekly contract hours (6 x 40 = 240) = 96 hours short, with hiring frozen past launch.
seams.suggested_resolution: Approve a freeze exception and out-of-hours budget, buy a managed overnight service, or delay the Premium tier.
seams.resolver_role: COO with Head of Support and Head of Finance

seams.title: Approval covers v1.4 but v2.0 ships
evidence: product/product_record.json: release_candidate 2.0 with three material changes and no change control request
seams.why_no_single_department_sees_it: Legal's approval is valid and unexpired for v1.4. The product record that shows v2.0 is not part of Legal's data.
seams.detection_logic: Approved version differs from release candidate and at least one change is material with no change control request filed.
seams.suggested_resolution: File a change control request and obtain Legal re-approval for v2.0 before release.
seams.resolver_role: Accountable senior manager with General Counsel

department_only_view: Each department shows minor findings only (HR 1, Finance 1 purchase order, Legal 1 expired contract and 1 unknown). Nothing blocks launch.
seam_view: Five seams. S1, S3, S4 and S5 block launch. S2 is conditional (restrict selling to trained staff).
